digest.component_or_area: Verified gate CI workflow (macOS pytest cell)
propositions: macOS default-suite step selects -m 'platform_compat and not external' but the platform_compat marker is applied only at collection time by tests/conftest.py, causing patchsets predating the auto-marker to collect zero tests

The Verified gate runs _build-and-test.yml from trusted main (reusable-workflow ref binding) against the raw patchset tree, creating a definition-versus-tree skew where the workflow definition references a marker not yet present in the patchset

A patchset whose base predates the platform_compat auto-marker entry point experiences pytest exit code 5 ('no tests ran') on macOS, blocking Verified +1, while Ubuntu cells pass because they run the full suite without marker selection
The regression was introduced by story omphacite-desertlike-coney (commit 920492b1) which split the contract across workflow selection and conftest marker application
The fix tolerates pytest exit code 5 on macOS only by capturing the exit code and mapping rc 5 to success, while Ubuntu cells still fail on rc 5 to catch real empty-suite failures
A behavioural test executes the real lane shell to assert macOS exit 0 / Ubuntu exit 5 when pytest collects zero platform_compat tests
